hero_title: Translate, transcribe, and OCR — 100% on your Mac.
hero_sub: LazyTranslator is a native, privacy-first macOS app that translates documents, transcribes audio and video into subtitles, and OCRs PDFs and images across 21 languages — including Burmese (မြန်မာ) and CJK — entirely on-device. Zero cloud uploads. Zero telemetry.
features_sub: Studio-grade language tools that never leave your Mac.
feat_doc_desc: Translate full documents across 21 languages with glossary enforcement and context-aware models tuned for 8–16 GB RAM Macs.
feat_audio_desc: Transcribe speech to text and generate .srt / .vtt subtitles locally with Whisper. Then translate them into bilingual subtitles in one pass.
feat_ocr_desc: Extract text from PDFs and images with Tesseract. Low-confidence words are flagged for quick review so nothing slips through.
feat_lang_desc: First-class support for Burmese (မြန်မာ) and CJK scripts with proper line spacing so stacked diacritics are never clipped.
step1d: Drag in a PDF, image, audio or video file — or paste text directly.
step2d: Extract text, translate, transcribe, or do transcription + translation in one pass.
step3d: Source/target languages and a Fast / Balanced / Best model tier matched to your Mac's RAM.
step4d: Processing happens entirely on your Apple Silicon GPU. Models download once, verified by SHA-256.
step5d: Edit results in a bilingual split view, then export as .txt, .md, .srt, .vtt, or .json.
privacy_title: Your data never leaves your Mac
privacy_1: Zero cloud uploads. All translation, transcription, and OCR run locally on your device.
privacy_2: Zero telemetry. No analytics, no crash reporters, no background network calls.
privacy_3: Offline by design. After the one-time model download, LazyTranslator works fully offline.
privacy_4: Models verified. Every AI model is checked with SHA-256 before use.
privacy_5: Open update policy. No background update checks — you decide when to update.
download_sub: Free to download. Pick the installation method that works best for you.
install_2: Drag LazyTranslator.app into your Applications folder.
req_2: Apple Silicon Mac (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4, arm64)
req_4: ~19 MB app installer (+ 1–5 GB of local AI models downloaded inside the app on first use)
upd_1_d: LazyTranslator never connects to the internet in the background on startup. You stay in control.
upd_2_d: Click Check for Updates → Install & Restart inside the app whenever you want. No uninstalling — your AI models, glossaries, and history are preserved.
upd_3_d: Installed via Homebrew? Update anytime with brew upgrade --cask lazytranslator.
